# docker.io/sbates130272/batesste-ci-images-ubuntu-rocm-rocjitsu:20261112.gdca6903-rocjitsu.50be05a
Usage: rocjitsu [options] -- APP [ARGS...]

Simulation configuration:
  --config VALUE
      Simulation config JSON (required)
  --node VALUE
      Select one local node from a system manifest. Required for multi-node launches. Not available with --attach
  --cpu-thread-budget VALUE
      Override CPU thread budget for this launch; zero selects automatic sizing. Not available with --attach
  --wait-checking VALUE
      Override wait checks: off disables checks, on enables ordinary checks, and all includes gfx1250 XCNT checks. Not available with --attach
  --thread-budget-table
      Print engine/dispatch allocations without running a VM

Launch modes:
  --daemon
      Run a daemon, optionally launching an application
  --attach
      Attach the application to a running daemon
  --vfio-socket VALUE
      Serve a VMM on this AF_UNIX socket. Requires ROCJITSU_ENABLE_VFIO=ON. Repeat once per local GPU in ordinal order
  --vfio-ready-fd VALUE
      Write readiness to this nonnegative file descriptor

Information:
  --check-vfio-user
      Report whether VFIO-user support is enabled
  --version, -v
      Print version
  --help, -h
      Show help

Application arguments must follow --. Examples:
  rocjitsu --config foo.json -- ./app
  rocjitsu --daemon --config foo.json -- ./app
  rocjitsu --daemon --config foo.json
  rocjitsu --attach --config foo.json -- ./app
  rocjitsu --config foo.json --vfio-socket /tmp/gpu.sock
  rocjitsu --config foo.json --vfio-socket /tmp/gpu0.sock --vfio-socket /tmp/gpu1.sock

Launch overrides apply only to this invocation and do not rewrite the source config.
VFIO serving requires ROCJITSU_ENABLE_VFIO=ON. VMM guest RAM must be shared, for example with -object memory-backend-memfd,id=mem,size=<N>,share=on and -machine memory-backend=mem.
